page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. A list of saints' invocations in lines, with a brace and marginal phrases "Ora pro nobis" beside the first and third groups, and a brace-linked phrase beside the second group. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.l: Omnes Sancti Martyres, Orate pro nobis.
Omnes Sancti Confessores, Orate pro nobis.

page.notes: The braces beside the groups are rendered as notes; the marginal "Ora pro nobis" phrases are printed in the right margin, the first beside Nicolae and the second beside Margaretha. The catchword at lower right reads "Omnes" (partly legible). Some letters are faint due to show-through from the reverse page.
